The room's organizing restates in the model's terms — a starter and calls for hands to place DCFU's name (t01), building, repair and mourning of the logo (t02), and traded help and coalitions with other DC subs (t05) — but its unused concepts of tracing which DC group made or changed the sign and of the builders alone deciding what it says (t03, t04; c0008, c0012, c0014, c0026, c0027) carry organizing the model lacks, the candidate tracer P06 and a builder-authority norm over who may alter a mark.
